name: 宠物智能用品商城演示数据

description.zh-CN:
5L 密封粮桶，1080p 摄像头，每天可设 10 餐，每份约 5g，适配 3–12mm 干粮；采用 5V 插电供电。

适合单猫或小型犬家庭，远程视频需 2.4GHz 网络。首次使用先称量连续 10 份出粮，再按实际克数设置计划；备用电池需另购。

每周拆洗粮碗或水盆并晾干；滤芯按型号和使用频率更换。电机、供电底座和插头不可浸水，重新装配后先检查，再交给宠物使用。
description.en:
A sealed 5L hopper, 1080p camera and up to 10 meals a day support portions of approximately 5g. Fits 3–12mm dry kibble and runs on 5V power.

Designed for one cat or a small dog. Remote video requires a 2.4GHz network. Weigh ten test portions before scheduling meals; backup batteries are sold separately.

Wash removable bowls or reservoirs weekly and dry thoroughly. Replace filters for the model and usage level. Never immerse motors, powered bases or plugs; check reassembly before pet use.

title.zh-CN: 绮芙洛米 5L 可视自动喂食器

subtitle.zh-CN: 准时开饭，也能看看它有没有吃好
subtitle.en: Schedule meals and check in at feeding time

value.en: One cat or a small dog

title.zh-CN: 暖芙里洛 3L 桌边定时喂食器

description.zh-CN:
3L 粮桶，每天最多 6 餐，每份约 6g；机身 18×18×29cm，配可拆不锈钢碗，5V 供电。

适合小户型单猫家庭，支持机身按键设定计划。只放干粮，不适用于湿粮或直径超过 12mm 的粮粒。

每周拆洗粮碗或水盆并晾干；滤芯按型号和使用频率更换。电机、供电底座和插头不可浸水，重新装配后先检查，再交给宠物使用。
description.en:
The 3L hopper supports six meals a day in roughly 6g portions. A removable steel bowl sits in an 18 × 18 × 29cm body powered by 5V.

A practical fit for smaller homes with one cat. Set schedules on the device itself. Use dry kibble only, with pieces no larger than 12mm.

Wash removable bowls or reservoirs weekly and dry thoroughly. Replace filters for the model and usage level. Never immerse motors, powered bases or plugs; check reassembly before pet use.

subtitle.zh-CN: 小巧粮桶，给日常喂食留出空间
subtitle.en: A compact hopper for an everyday feeding routine

title.zh-CN: 泽柯珞拉 4L 双碗分流喂食器

description.zh-CN:
4L 粮桶，双出口分流，可设 8 餐，单次总出粮约 10–80g；两碗中心间距 24cm。

适合进食节奏接近的两只宠物。分流量受粮形影响，需分别称重校准；不适合必须严格分开饮食的家庭。

每周拆洗粮碗或水盆并晾干；滤芯按型号和使用频率更换。电机、供电底座和插头不可浸水，重新装配后先检查，再交给宠物使用。
description.en:
A 4L hopper feeds two outlets with up to eight scheduled meals. Total servings range from about 10–80g; bowl centers are 24cm apart.

Suited to two pets with similar eating habits. Check each bowl by weight because kibble shape affects the split. Separate feeding is needed when diets must stay strictly apart.

Wash removable bowls or reservoirs weekly and dry thoroughly. Replace filters for the model and usage level. Never immerse motors, powered bases or plugs; check reassembly before pet use.

subtitle.zh-CN: 两只食碗，固定餐点更省心
subtitle.en: Two bowls for a consistent mealtime routine

description.zh-CN:
容量可选 2L 或 3L；红外感应距离约 1m，5V 供电，滤芯由棉层、活性炭和树脂组成。

适合室内猫犬饮水，可切换持续循环模式。每天查看水位并换入新鲜饮水，不以容量推算可以无人照看的天数。

每周拆洗粮碗或水盆并晾干；滤芯按型号和使用频率更换。电机、供电底座和插头不可浸水，重新装配后先检查，再交给宠物使用。
description.en:
Choose a 2L or 3L reservoir. An infrared sensor triggers flow within approximately 1m. The 5V system uses a cotton, activated-carbon and resin filter.

For indoor cats and dogs, with a continuous-flow option. Check the level and refresh the water daily; capacity is not a measure of how long a pet can be left unattended.

Wash removable bowls or reservoirs weekly and dry thoroughly. Replace filters for the model and usage level. Never immerse motors, powered bases or plugs; check reassembly before pet use.

title.zh-CN: 米芙奇洛 感应循环智能饮水机

subtitle.zh-CN: 靠近出水，低水位亮灯提醒
subtitle.en: Water on approach, with a low-water indicator

value.zh-CN: 红外感应出水，可切换持续循环
棉层 + 活性炭 + 树脂

description.zh-CN:
3L 容量，304 不锈钢上盆，两档水流；水泵额定 2W，供电线长 1.5m，5V 供电。

适合偏爱流动水的猫，也可供小型犬使用。放在平整台面，水泵需保持浸没；缺水灯亮后及时加水。

每周拆洗粮碗或水盆并晾干；滤芯按型号和使用频率更换。电机、供电底座和插头不可浸水，重新装配后先检查，再交给宠物使用。
description.en:
A 3L reservoir sits beneath a 304 stainless steel basin. Two flow settings use a 2W pump, with a 1.5m cable and 5V power.

For cats that prefer moving water and for small dogs. Place on a level surface and keep the pump submerged. Refill promptly when the low-water light comes on.

Wash removable bowls or reservoirs weekly and dry thoroughly. Replace filters for the model and usage level. Never immerse motors, powered bases or plugs; check reassembly before pet use.

title.zh-CN: 欧芙旭里 3L 不锈钢饮水机

subtitle.zh-CN: 可拆钢盆，让日常刷洗更顺手
subtitle.en: A removable steel basin makes cleaning easier

title.zh-CN: 塔柯维诺 饮水机复合滤芯 6 枚装

description.zh-CN:
每盒 6 枚，单枚 60×60×10mm；适配本店感应循环饮水机，不适配 3L 不锈钢款。

安装前用饮用水冲洗并浸泡 5 分钟，通常每 2–4 周更换；多宠或水质较硬时缩短周期。

每周拆洗粮碗或水盆并晾干；滤芯按型号和使用频率更换。电机、供电底座和插头不可浸水，重新装配后先检查，再交给宠物使用。
description.en:
Contains six 60 × 60 × 10mm filters. Fits this collection's motion-activated fountain, but not the 3L stainless steel model.

Rinse with drinking water and soak for five minutes before fitting. Replace every two to four weeks, or sooner in multi-pet homes or with hard water.

Wash removable bowls or reservoirs weekly and dry thoroughly. Replace filters for the model and usage level. Never immerse motors, powered bases or plugs; check reassembly before pet use.

subtitle.zh-CN: 按时换芯，让循环水路保持畅通
subtitle.en: Fresh filters help keep the fountain flowing

title.zh-CN: 维奇茉拉 喂食器替换食碗套装

description.zh-CN:
含 2 只 304 不锈钢碗，每只直径 14cm、深 3cm，适配 3L 桌边定时喂食器。

适合每日换洗或两处摆放食碗。购买前核对设备型号，碗沿卡位不适配双碗分流款。

每周拆洗粮碗或水盆并晾干；滤芯按型号和使用频率更换。电机、供电底座和插头不可浸水，重新装配后先检查，再交给宠物使用。
description.en:
Includes two 304 stainless steel bowls, each 14cm wide and 3cm deep. Designed for the 3L compact scheduled feeder.

Useful for daily bowl rotation or feeding in two spots. Check the model before ordering; the rim fittings do not fit the twin-bowl feeder.

Wash removable bowls or reservoirs weekly and dry thoroughly. Replace filters for the model and usage level. Never immerse motors, powered bases or plugs; check reassembly before pet use.

subtitle.zh-CN: 备用一只碗，轮换清洗更从容
subtitle.en: Keep a spare bowl ready for cleaning days

description.zh-CN:
68L 内舱，8L 集便仓，入口直径 25cm；适用体重 1.5–8kg 的成年猫，额定 24W，适配结团矿砂。

离盆后等待 5 分钟再清理，入口与重量感应触发时暂停。幼猫和体重范围外的猫不启用自动模式，初次使用需主人观察。

处理污物前断电，戴手套清洁可拆部件并晾干；电子底座只擦拭。清理感应窗口积尘，耗材按兼容型号使用，换袋后检查固定状态。
description.en:
A 68L chamber and 8L drawer have a 25cm entry. For adult cats weighing 1.5–8kg, with 24W rated power. Uses clumping mineral litter.

Starts cleaning five minutes after departure and pauses on entry or weight sensor signals. Keep automatic mode off for kittens and cats outside the stated range; supervise first use.

Unplug before handling waste. Wear gloves to clean removable parts and dry fully; wipe powered bases only. Keep sensors clear, match supplies to compatible models and check liner fittings.

title.zh-CN: 绮芙洛米 68L 自动清理猫砂盆

subtitle.zh-CN: 离盆延时清理，少一点每天铲砂的忙碌
subtitle.en: Delayed cleaning takes some work out of litter duty

description.zh-CN:
砂盘 45×32cm，集便盒 4L，耙齿间隙 6mm；适合结团矿砂，24V 供电，猫离开后延时 10 分钟清理。

适合体重 2–7kg 的成年猫。沿刻度加砂，避免过量导致耙齿受阻；长条豆腐砂不适合此结构，幼猫使用时关闭自动模式。

处理污物前断电，戴手套清洁可拆部件并晾干；电子底座只擦拭。清理感应窗口积尘，耗材按兼容型号使用，换袋后检查固定状态。
description.en:
The 45 × 32cm tray uses a 4L bin and a rake with 6mm spacing. Uses clumping mineral litter and 24V power, with a ten-minute departure delay.

For adult cats weighing 2–7kg. Fill to the line to avoid obstructing the rake. Long tofu-litter pellets are unsuitable; disable automatic mode for kittens.

Unplug before handling waste. Wear gloves to clean removable parts and dry fully; wipe powered bases only. Keep sensors clear, match supplies to compatible models and check liner fittings.

title.zh-CN: 暖芙里洛 开放式自动平耙猫砂盆

subtitle.zh-CN: 开放入口，给不爱钻舱的猫一个选择
subtitle.en: An open entrance for cats that dislike enclosed boxes

title.zh-CN: 泽柯珞拉 猫砂区循环除味风机

description.zh-CN:
USB 5V 供电，额定 3W，两档风速，配可更换活性炭片；机身 12×12×6cm。

适合放在猫砂区侧面，风口保持至少 10cm 空间。使用风机与滤片，不使用臭氧发生器，也不能替代铲砂和通风。

处理污物前断电，戴手套清洁可拆部件并晾干；电子底座只擦拭。清理感应窗口积尘，耗材按兼容型号使用，换袋后检查固定状态。
description.en:
A USB-powered 5V, 3W fan offers two speeds and a replaceable carbon pad. The body measures 12 × 12 × 6cm.

Place beside the litter area with at least 10cm clear around vents. Uses a fan and carbon pad without an ozone generator. Regular scooping and ventilation are still needed.

Unplug before handling waste. Wear gloves to clean removable parts and dry fully; wipe powered bases only. Keep sensors clear, match supplies to compatible models and check liner fittings.

subtitle.zh-CN: 循环送风，照顾小空间的气味体验
subtitle.en: Filtered airflow for smaller litter areas

description.zh-CN:
杯口直径 8cm，硅胶刷内衬可拆，转速约 60rpm；电池 1200mAh，USB 5V 充电。

适合爪宽不超过 6cm 的犬只。只加常温清水，先让宠物接触静止杯体，清洗后用毛巾擦干。

处理污物前断电，戴手套清洁可拆部件并晾干；电子底座只擦拭。清理感应窗口积尘，耗材按兼容型号使用，换袋后检查固定状态。
description.en:
An 8cm opening holds a removable silicone liner rotating at about 60rpm. The 1200mAh battery charges from USB 5V.

For dogs with paws up to 6cm wide. Use room-temperature water, introduce the cup with the motor off, and towel-dry paws afterwards.

Unplug before handling waste. Wear gloves to clean removable parts and dry fully; wipe powered bases only. Keep sensors clear, match supplies to compatible models and check liner fittings.

title.zh-CN: 米芙奇洛 旋转软刷洗爪杯

subtitle.zh-CN: 散步回来，低速软刷洗掉浮尘
subtitle.en: A gentle brush cycle for dusty paws after walks

title.zh-CN: 欧芙旭里 集便仓抽绳袋 40 只装

description.zh-CN:
40 只装，单只平铺 45×50cm，厚约 0.025mm；适配 68L 自动清理猫砂盆的 8L 集便仓。

袋边压在固定槽内，勿遮住感应区域。满袋及时更换，扎紧袋口后按当地生活垃圾要求处理。

处理污物前断电，戴手套清洁可拆部件并晾干；电子底座只擦拭。清理感应窗口积尘，耗材按兼容型号使用，换袋后检查固定状态。
description.en:
Forty liners, each 45 × 50cm laid flat and about 0.025mm thick. Fits the 8L drawer in the 68L self-cleaning box.

Secure edges in the retaining groove without covering sensors. Replace when full, tie closed and follow local household-waste rules.

Unplug before handling waste. Wear gloves to clean removable parts and dry fully; wipe powered bases only. Keep sensors clear, match supplies to compatible models and check liner fittings.

subtitle.zh-CN: 抽绳收口，换袋少接触
subtitle.en: Drawstring closure makes changing liners easier

title.zh-CN: 塔柯维诺 除味风机活性炭片 4 片装

description.zh-CN:
4 片装，每片 90×90×8mm，仅适配猫砂区循环除味风机；无香精添加。

建议每 4 周检查，积尘明显或气味体验下降时更换。滤片不可水洗，不适用于猫砂盆集便仓。

处理污物前断电，戴手套清洁可拆部件并晾干；电子底座只擦拭。清理感应窗口积尘，耗材按兼容型号使用，换袋后检查固定状态。
description.en:
Four 90 × 90 × 8mm pads for the litter-area carbon filter fan only. No added fragrance.

Inspect every four weeks and replace if dusty or less effective. These pads cannot be washed and are not waste-drawer filters.

Unplug before handling waste. Wear gloves to clean removable parts and dry fully; wipe powered bases only. Keep sensors clear, match supplies to compatible models and check liner fittings.

subtitle.zh-CN: 备好替换片，维持顺畅风路
subtitle.en: Keep spare pads ready for clear airflow

title.zh-CN: 维奇茉拉 旋转夜视宠物摄像头

description.zh-CN:
1080p 视频，水平旋转 350°、俯仰 60°，红外夜视约 5m；支持最大 128GB 存储卡，卡需另购。

适合客厅观察与双向语音，需 2.4GHz 网络和 5V 插电。仅放在室内，避开私密区域和宠物可咬到的线材。

充电和安装时让宠物远离设备，线材沿墙固定。玩具在看护下使用，破损附件及时收起；摄像头定期检查访问权限并擦拭镜头。
description.en:
1080p video with 350° pan, 60° tilt and infrared night vision up to roughly 5m. Supports cards up to 128GB, sold separately.

For living-room check-ins and two-way audio over a 2.4GHz network, with 5V power. Use indoors and avoid private areas and chewable cable routes.

Keep pets away during charging and setup and secure cables along a wall. Supervise toys and remove damaged parts. Review camera access permissions and wipe lenses regularly.

subtitle.zh-CN: 转动视角，看看它今天躲在哪儿
subtitle.en: Pan around the room to find a favorite hiding spot

value.zh-CN: 最大 128GB 存储卡（需另购）

description.zh-CN:
2K 视频，零食仓 300mL，适配 5–10mm 干燥零食；每次约 1–3 颗，USB 5V 供电，需 2.4GHz 网络。

适合短时离家互动。零食计入每日摄入，先在家测试投射距离；不放软黏、油脂过多或碎屑较多的零食。

充电和安装时让宠物远离设备，线材沿墙固定。玩具在看护下使用，破损附件及时收起；摄像头定期检查访问权限并擦拭镜头。
description.en:
2K video and a 300mL hopper take 5–10mm dry treats, releasing about one to three at a time. Uses USB 5V power and a 2.4GHz network.

For brief check-ins while away. Count treats toward daily intake and test the launch distance at home. Avoid sticky, oily or crumbly treats.

Keep pets away during charging and setup and secure cables along a wall. Supervise toys and remove damaged parts. Review camera access permissions and wipe lenses regularly.

title.zh-CN: 绮芙洛米 零食投喂互动摄像头

subtitle.zh-CN: 看看它，也给它一小口奖励
subtitle.en: Check in and offer a small reward

title.zh-CN: 暖芙里洛 避障滚动互动球

description.zh-CN:
球径 6cm，电池 400mAh，慢速与标准两档；运行 10 分钟休眠，支持触碰唤醒，5V 充电。

适合硬地板上的猫咪追逐游戏。避开楼梯、厚地毯和积水，首次玩耍需主人陪同，不让宠物啃咬充电口。

充电和安装时让宠物远离设备，线材沿墙固定。玩具在看护下使用，破损附件及时收起；摄像头定期检查访问权限并擦拭镜头。
description.en:
A 6cm ball with a 400mAh battery offers slow and standard modes. Sleeps after ten minutes and wakes on contact. Charges at 5V.

For supervised cat play on hard floors. Keep away from stairs, deep carpet and wet areas. Introduce with supervision and prevent chewing near the charging port.

Keep pets away during charging and setup and secure cables along a wall. Supervise toys and remove damaged parts. Review camera access permissions and wipe lenses regularly.

subtitle.zh-CN: 随机滚动，让室内游戏多点变化
subtitle.en: Unpredictable movement adds variety to indoor play

description.zh-CN:
底座直径 18cm，摆臂长 22cm，三档摆动速度；单轮 8 分钟，电池 1500mAh，5V 充电。

适合主人在旁时地面互动，不连续整天运行。收起松动羽毛和绳线，表现紧张时停止并改为手动陪玩。

充电和安装时让宠物远离设备，线材沿墙固定。玩具在看护下使用，破损附件及时收起；摄像头定期检查访问权限并擦拭镜头。
description.en:
An 18cm base supports a 22cm arm with three speeds. Each session lasts eight minutes; the 1500mAh battery charges at 5V.

For floor-level play with a person nearby, rather than all-day operation. Remove loose feathers or cords and switch to hand-held play if your pet seems uneasy.

Keep pets away during charging and setup and secure cables along a wall. Supervise toys and remove damaged parts. Review camera access permissions and wipe lenses regularly.

title.zh-CN: 泽柯珞拉 定时摆动逗猫台

subtitle.zh-CN: 短时摆动，陪它活动一会儿
subtitle.en: Short play sessions with a moving feather wand

title.zh-CN: 米芙奇洛 互动球替换软壳套装
title.en: Mivqelo Replacement Soft Shells for Rolling Toy

description.zh-CN:
含两只直径 6cm 硅胶外壳，适配避障滚动互动球，预留充电孔位；不含球芯。

适合原壳磨损后的替换。套入前关闭电源，安装后检查无松脱；外壳出现缺口时停止使用。

充电和安装时让宠物远离设备，线材沿墙固定。玩具在看护下使用，破损附件及时收起；摄像头定期检查访问权限并擦拭镜头。
description.en:
Two 6cm silicone shells for the obstacle-aware rolling toy, with charging-port cutouts. Motorized core not included.

Replace worn shells with the power off. Check that the new shell sits securely; stop use if it tears or develops missing pieces.

Keep pets away during charging and setup and secure cables along a wall. Supervise toys and remove damaged parts. Review camera access permissions and wipe lenses regularly.

subtitle.zh-CN: 换个外壳，继续滚动玩耍
subtitle.en: Refresh the shell and keep playtime rolling

title.zh-CN: 欧芙旭里 摄像头可调墙面支架
title.en: Orvexuli Adjustable Wall Mount for Pet Camera

description.zh-CN:
承重 1kg，俯仰调节 90°，底板 7×7cm；配固定螺钉，适配旋转夜视宠物摄像头。

适合结实墙面，建议安装高度 1.5–2m。按墙体选择膨胀件，不安装在疏松饰面或宠物能攀爬拉扯的位置。

充电和安装时让宠物远离设备，线材沿墙固定。玩具在看护下使用，破损附件及时收起；摄像头定期检查访问权限并擦拭镜头。
description.en:
Rated for 1kg, with 90° tilt adjustment and a 7 × 7cm base plate. Includes screws and fits the pan-and-tilt pet camera.

Mount on a sound wall at about 1.5–2m. Use wall-appropriate anchors and avoid loose finishes or spots your pet can climb to and pull at.

Keep pets away during charging and setup and secure cables along a wall. Supervise toys and remove damaged parts. Review camera access permissions and wipe lenses regularly.

subtitle.zh-CN: 抬高视角，避开爪子和尾巴
subtitle.en: Lift the view above paws and tails

title.zh-CN: 塔柯维诺 户外卫星定位挂件

description.zh-CN:
42×35×16mm，重 32g，电池 800mAh；卫星定位与移动网络回传，含 30 天演示流量，后续流量另购。

For dogs over 5kg. Requires satellite reception and network coverage; accuracy may drop indoors. The tag does not replace a leash or guarantee recovery.

Check charge, fittings and webbing before trips. Keep electronics out of water; wipe and dry afterwards. Wash bowls separately. Tracking and lighting are aids; use suitable restraints and supervision.

适合猫和中小型犬在家记录。固定同一时间和地面，站稳后读数；显示分度不代表每次测量的绝对误差。

电子主体用干软布擦拭，不浸水；可拆钢碗与防滑垫分别清洗晾干。长期不用时取出可拆电池，记录条件尽量一致，数值不作为诊断依据。
description.en:
Weighs 0.2–20kg in displayed increments of 10g on a 55 × 32cm platform. Uses two AAA batteries, sold separately.

For home logs for cats and small to medium dogs. Use the same time and floor surface and wait for a steady stance. Display resolution is not a guarantee of absolute accuracy.

Wipe electronics with a dry cloth and keep out of water. Wash removable bowls and mats separately. Remove replaceable batteries for storage. Keep recording conditions consistent; readings are not diagnostic.

subtitle.zh-CN: 记录体重变化，从每次站稳开始
subtitle.en: Track weight trends one steady reading at a time

value.en: Cats and small to medium dogs

title.zh-CN: 塔柯维诺 食物称量智能碗秤

description.zh-CN:

适合称量干粮和湿粮。以包装建议与实际情况确定分量，秤只记录重量，不提供饮食诊断。

电子主体用干软布擦拭，不浸水；可拆钢碗与防滑垫分别清洗晾干。长期不用时取出可拆电池，记录条件尽量一致，数值不作为诊断依据。
description.en:
Measures 1–2000g in 1g displayed increments, with a removable 800mL steel bowl. Includes tare and gram/ounce modes.

For dry and wet food. Choose portions using the food label and your pet's needs. The scale records weight and does not provide dietary diagnoses.

Wipe electronics with a dry cloth and keep out of water. Wash removable bowls and mats separately. Remove replaceable batteries for storage. Keep recording conditions consistent; readings are not diagnostic.

description.zh-CN:

适合体重 3kg 以上猫犬日常观察。数据是运动估计，不能识别疾病；佩戴后出现抓挠或不适时取下。

电子主体用干软布擦拭，不浸水；可拆钢碗与防滑垫分别清洗晾干。长期不用时取出可拆电池，记录条件尽量一致，数值不作为诊断依据。
description.en:
A 12g tag with a 90mAh battery records active and still periods. Sync up to seven days of history over Bluetooth. Charges at 5V.

For everyday observation of cats and dogs over 3kg. Readings estimate movement and cannot detect illness. Remove if your pet scratches at it or seems uncomfortable.

Wipe electronics with a dry cloth and keep out of water. Wash removable bowls and mats separately. Remove replaceable batteries for storage. Keep recording conditions consistent; readings are not diagnostic.

适合颈围在调节范围内的犬只，防泼溅但不用于游泳。步态影响统计，只供生活记录，异常行为需专业评估。

For dogs within the collar's fit range. Splash resistant, but not for swimming. Gait affects estimates; use for routine logs and seek professional assessment for unusual behavior.

Wipe electronics with a dry cloth and keep out of water. Wash removable bowls and mats separately. Remove replaceable batteries for storage. Keep recording conditions consistent; readings are not diagnostic.

适合能自行离窝的成年猫或小型犬。温度受室温和覆盖物影响，不叠厚毯，不用于行动受限宠物的无人看护场景。

清洁前拔电，布套与电子部件分开处理，完全干燥再通电。每次检查线材、接口和垫面，观察宠物是否愿意使用，破损或异常发热时停用。

A 50cm bed uses 24V, 20W heating with surface targets of 30, 35 or 38°C and two- or six-hour timers.

For adult cats and small dogs that can leave on their own. Room temperature and coverings affect warmth. Avoid thick blankets and unattended use with pets of limited mobility.

Unplug before cleaning and separate fabric from electronics. Reconnect only when dry. Inspect cables, connections and surfaces each time; check comfort and stop for damage or unusual heat.

Unplug before cleaning and separate fabric from electronics. Reconnect only when dry. Inspect cables, connections and surfaces each time; check comfort and stop for damage or unusual heat.

清洁前拔电，布套与电子部件分开处理，完全干燥再通电。每次检查线材、接口和垫面，观察宠物是否愿意使用，破损或异常发热时停用。

Place 0.5–1m above the floor near the bed, away from direct airflow, sunlight and steam. Adjustable alerts do not control cooling equipment or assess health.

清洁前拔电，布套与电子部件分开处理，完全干燥再通电。每次检查线材、接口和垫面，观察宠物是否愿意使用，破损或异常发热时停用。
description.en:
One zippered polyester cover for the 50cm low-voltage heated round bed. Heating parts not included.

Unplug and remove heating parts before changing. Wash gently below 30°C and dry fully before refitting. Do not use around other heating-pad models.

Unplug before cleaning and separate fabric from electronics. Reconnect only when dry. Inspect cables, connections and surfaces each time; check comfort and stop for damage or unusual heat.

减少线材裸露但不保证防咬。留出插头散热空间，每次检查线皮，破损时停止设备使用。

清洁前拔电，布套与电子部件分开处理，完全干燥再通电。每次检查线材、接口和垫面，观察宠物是否愿意使用，破损或异常发热时停用。

Reduces exposed cable length but is not chew-proof. Leave ventilation around plugs and inspect insulation before use. Stop using damaged devices.

Unplug before cleaning and separate fabric from electronics. Reconnect only when dry. Inspect cables, connections and surfaces each time; check comfort and stop for damage or unusual heat.

subtitle.zh-CN: 整理窝边线材，减少裸露线段

title.zh-CN: 泽柯珞拉 双格定时湿粮餐盘

description.zh-CN:

适合主人在家观察下的短时分餐，冰袋只能延缓升温，不能保证长时保鲜。依粮食包装和室温缩短放置时间，剩余湿粮及时丢弃。

For short meal intervals with supervision at home. Ice packs slow warming but do not guarantee extended freshness. Follow food storage guidance and room conditions, and discard leftovers promptly.

Wash removable bowls or reservoirs weekly and dry thoroughly. Replace filters for the model and usage level. Never immerse motors, powered bases or plugs; check reassembly before pet use.

subtitle.zh-CN: 按时打开餐盖，湿粮分餐更方便

title.zh-CN: 米芙奇洛 猫砂盆维护铲刷套装

含一把 28cm 长砂铲和一把 18cm 长软毛刷，砂铲筛孔 5mm；不含猫砂和电子部件。

适合补充手动铲砂和清理可拆砂盘角落。设备先断电，刷子不伸入电机与传动部位，处理后用温和清洁剂洗净晾干。

处理污物前断电，戴手套清洁可拆部件并晾干；电子底座只擦拭。清理感应窗口积尘，耗材按兼容型号使用，换袋后检查固定状态。
description.en:
Includes a 28cm scoop with 5mm slots and an 18cm soft brush. Litter and electronics are not included.

For manual scooping and cleaning corners of removable trays. Unplug first and keep the brush out of motors and drives. Wash with mild detergent and dry after use.

Unplug before handling waste. Wear gloves to clean removable parts and dry fully; wipe powered bases only. Keep sensors clear, match supplies to compatible models and check liner fittings.

subtitle.zh-CN: 手动清理工具，角落也好打理
subtitle.en: Manual tools for everyday cleanup and awkward corners

title.zh-CN: 欧芙旭里 5kg 小宠托盘电子秤

description.zh-CN:
称量范围 50g–5kg，显示分度 1g，托盘 40×25cm，带读数保持与去皮功能；两节七号电池需另购。

适合小体型猫犬短时称量，主人全程在旁，托盘不是固定约束。铺薄巾后先去皮，宠物活动时多测几次，不将保持读数视为准确保证。

电子主体用干软布擦拭，不浸水；可拆钢碗与防滑垫分别清洗晾干。长期不用时取出可拆电池，记录条件尽量一致，数值不作为诊断依据。
description.en:
Measures 50g–5kg with 1g display increments on a 40 × 25cm tray. Includes hold and tare functions; two AAA batteries are sold separately.

For brief weigh-ins of smaller cats and dogs with constant supervision; the tray is not a restraint. Tare after adding a thin towel and repeat readings if the pet moves. Hold mode does not guarantee accuracy.

Wipe electronics with a dry cloth and keep out of water. Wash removable bowls and mats separately. Remove replaceable batteries for storage. Keep recording conditions consistent; readings are not diagnostic.

subtitle.zh-CN: 浅弧托盘，记录小体型宠物的体重
subtitle.en: A shallow cradle for weighing smaller pets

title.zh-CN: 自动喂食器怎么选：先看粮粒，再看餐次
title.en: Choosing a Feeder: Kibble First, Schedule Second

content.zh-CN:
量常用干粮直径，核对设备支持范围。湿粮、黏性零食和过长粮粒不放入干粮喂食器。

容量影响补粮频率，不代表可以长期不照看宠物。用食物秤称连续 10 份出粮，按实际平均克数计算每餐份数。

远程款检查 2.4GHz 网络，备用电池核对型号。上班前在家试运行一整天，观察出粮和宠物适应情况。
content.en:
Measure your usual kibble and check compatibility. Wet food, sticky treats and oversized pieces do not belong in a dry-food feeder.

Capacity changes refill frequency, not how long pets can be left alone. Weigh ten servings and use their average to set meal portions.

Check 2.4GHz coverage for connected models and the correct backup batteries. Run a full-day trial at home before relying on workday schedules.

summary.zh-CN: 核对粮型、份量与备用供电，再决定容量。
summary.en: Check kibble, portions and backup power before capacity.

title.zh-CN: 智能猫砂盆选购：入口和砂型同样重要
title.en: Choosing a Litter Box: Size and Litter Matter

content.zh-CN:
核对入口直径、内舱空间与体重范围，确保宠物能自然转身。幼猫和范围外的猫不启用自动清理。

旋转筛砂和平耙结构的适用砂型不同。按刻度加砂，过量或不兼容猫砂可能阻碍机构运动。

保留旧盆过渡，新设备先用手动模式。主人观察数次进出，适应后再启用离盆延时清理。
content.en:
Check entry size, internal room and weight range for comfortable turning. Disable automatic cycles for kittens and cats outside the stated range.

Drum and rake systems accept different litter. Fill to the mark; excess or incompatible litter can obstruct movement.

Keep the old box during transition and begin in manual mode. Watch several visits before enabling delayed automatic cleaning.

summary.zh-CN: 量好体型，核对猫砂，再看清理结构。
summary.en: Measure your cat and check litter before comparing mechanisms.

title.zh-CN: 定位挂件怎么选：近距寻找还是户外记录
title.en: Choosing a Tracker: Nearby Finding or Outdoor History

content.zh-CN:
蓝牙挂件适合室内找项圈，超出范围无法持续定位。卫星定位挂件需要卫星接收和移动网络回传。

核对重量、项圈宽度和最低适用体重。佩戴后留两指间隙，观察是否碰碗或引起抓挠。

比较后续流量费用与充电频率，出门前检查电量。建筑密集处误差可能增大，定位器不保证找回，牵引与看护仍是基础。
content.en:
Bluetooth tags find collars nearby but stop updating out of range. Satellite trackers need satellite reception and a mobile network.

Check weight, collar width and minimum pet size. Leave a two-finger gap and watch for bowl contact or scratching.

Compare data costs and charging needs. Check charge before leaving. Buildings can reduce accuracy; recovery is not guaranteed, so leashes and supervision remain essential.

summary.zh-CN: 连接范围、后续费用与佩戴重量都要考虑。
summary.en: Consider range, ongoing costs and wearable weight.

title.zh-CN: 饮水机用了，换水和刷洗也别省
title.en: A Fountain Still Needs Fresh Water and Cleaning

content.zh-CN:
每天检查水量、毛发和食物碎屑，换入新鲜饮水。多宠家庭增加独立水碗，不让全部宠物依赖同一个设备。

每周断电拆洗水盆、出水口和可拆泵盖，用软刷清理沉积。带电底座与插头不可浸水。

滤芯先冲洗浸泡，按水质与使用频率更换。流量变小先查水位、毛发和泵内沉积，装回前确认部件干燥。
content.en:
Check level, hair and food debris daily and refresh with drinking water. Add separate bowls in multi-pet homes so one device is not the only source.

Unplug weekly and wash the reservoir, outlet and removable pump cover. Brush away deposits and keep powered bases and plugs out of water.

Rinse and soak new filters and replace according to water quality and use. Check level, hair and pump deposits for reduced flow; dry parts before reassembly.

summary.zh-CN: 循环水也需要固定的清洁安排。
summary.en: Moving water needs a regular cleaning routine too.

title.zh-CN: 室内互动玩具：短一点，陪着玩

content.zh-CN:
首次使用先关闭电源，让宠物闻一闻，再开慢速。收好电线、小物件和易倒摆件，避开楼梯。

每轮玩 5–10 分钟，观察是否主动追逐。躲藏或紧张时停止，留出离开游戏区的路线。

结束后收起羽毛、绳线与小配件，检查外壳咬痕。自动玩具只是互动的一部分，仍需要主人陪玩和稳定休息。
content.en:
Introduce with power off, then start slowly. Clear cables, small objects and unstable decorations, and avoid stairs.

Try five- to ten-minute sessions and watch for willing engagement. Stop for hiding or distress and leave a clear way out.

Put away feathers, cords and small parts afterwards and check bite damage. Powered toys are one part of enrichment; pets still need people and predictable rest.

summary.zh-CN: 把自动玩具加入陪玩，跟着宠物自己的节奏。
summary.en: Include powered toys in playtime and follow your pet's pace.

title.zh-CN: 恒温窝垫怎么摆：给宠物留出选择
title.en: Setting Up Heated Beds: Leave Room to Choose

content.zh-CN:
核对电压、尺寸与定时功能，放在干燥通风处。沿墙整理线材，不压在家具脚下，避免啃咬。

从低档开始，旁边留不加热区域。不叠厚毯，实际温度受室温与覆盖物影响，使用时定期查看。

无法自行离窝的宠物需特别看护，不安排无人值守加热。洗布套前拔电并取出加热部件，彻底晾干再装回。
content.en:
Check voltage, size and timer settings. Place in a dry, ventilated area and route cables away from furniture legs and chewing.

Start low and leave an unheated space nearby. Avoid thick blankets; ambient conditions and coverings affect temperature, so check regularly.

Pets unable to leave need close supervision and no unattended heating. Unplug and remove heating parts before washing covers; dry fully before refitting.

summary.zh-CN: 温暖区域旁也留一处普通休息位。
summary.en: Keep an unheated resting spot beside the warm one.

本次专区包含六组商品分类，并补充常用耗材。分类页可查看用途，配件页注明兼容范围。

summary.en: Explore feeding, cleaning, play, travel, tracking and comfort.

title.zh-CN: 设备连不上无线网络怎么办？

content.zh-CN:
联网喂食器与摄像头使用 2.4GHz 网络。手机先连接同一频段，确认网络可用，把设备放在路由器附近测试。

按设备说明进入配网模式，看到状态灯再操作。检查密码和本地网络权限，失败后退出配网重试。

合并频段可临时区分网络名称再配对。重置可能清除计划，操作前记下餐次与份量。
content.en:
Connected feeders and cameras use 2.4GHz. Connect your phone to that band, check internet access and test near the router.

Enter pairing mode as instructed and wait for the status light. Check password and local-network permissions, then restart pairing if needed.

Temporarily separate band names if necessary. Resetting may erase schedules; note meal times and portions first.

summary.zh-CN: 先核对频段，再检查配网状态。
summary.en: Check the band and pairing mode first.

title.zh-CN: 活动挂件和传感器如何同步？
title.en: Syncing Activity Tags and Room Sensors

content.zh-CN:
确认设备有电，手机蓝牙开启，允许附近设备权限。首次绑定放在手机 1m 内。

选择对应型号绑定，进入记录页刷新。轻量挂件保存近 7 天记录，建议每天同步避免覆盖旧记录。

离开蓝牙范围不会持续上传。异常先检查电量和绑定，不反复重置，以免丢失未同步记录。
content.en:
Check power, enable Bluetooth and allow nearby-device access. Keep within 1m for first pairing.

Select the matching model and refresh records after pairing. The lightweight logger stores seven days; sync daily to avoid overwriting older entries.

No continuous upload occurs outside Bluetooth range. Check charge and pairing before resetting, as unsynced records may be lost.

summary.zh-CN: 近距离打开蓝牙，查看更新时间。
summary.en: Enable Bluetooth nearby and check the update time.

title.zh-CN: 首次使用怎么校准出粮份量？

content.zh-CN:
核对粮粒尺寸，清洗晾干粮桶和食碗。装少量干粮，手动出粮数次让通道填满。

称连续 10 份，计算平均克数，按包装建议和实际进食情况设置。更换粮型后重新校准。

先在家试运行，确认时间、出粮和备用供电。卡粮时断电清理，不触碰运行中的机构。
content.en:
Check kibble size and clean and dry the hopper and bowl. Add a little kibble and dispense several times to fill the chute.

Weigh ten portions and calculate the average. Set meals using the label and feeding routine. Recalibrate after changing kibble.

Test at home, including timing, portions and backup power. Unplug before clearing jams and never touch a moving mechanism.

summary.zh-CN: 用同一款粮称量，再设置餐次。
summary.en: Weigh your usual kibble before scheduling.

title.zh-CN: 饮水机多久清洗，滤芯多久更换？

content.zh-CN:
每日检查水位并换水，及时清毛发。每周断电拆下水盆、出水组件和可拆泵盖，用软刷清洁。

滤芯通常每 2–4 周更换，多宠或水质较硬时提前。新滤芯冲洗并浸泡 5 分钟。

检查密封圈、水泵安装后加水通电。底座不浸水，不同型号尺寸不同，购买前核对兼容说明。
content.en:
Refresh daily and remove hair. Unplug weekly and brush the basin, outlet and removable pump cover.

Change filters every two to four weeks, sooner with multiple pets or hard water. Rinse and soak new filters for five minutes.

Check seals and pump seating before refilling and powering on. Keep bases dry and verify filter compatibility before buying.

summary.zh-CN: 每天换水，每周拆洗，按使用情况换芯。
summary.en: Refresh daily, wash weekly and replace filters for your usage.

title.zh-CN: 猫砂盆清洁与集便袋更换步骤
title.en: Cleaning a Litter Box and Changing Liners

content.zh-CN:
确认猫离开，暂停自动清理并断电。戴手套取袋扎紧，按当地生活垃圾要求处理。

按说明拆洗砂盘，用温和清洁剂洗净晾干。电子底座只擦拭，清理入口和感应窗口积尘。

固定新袋边，不遮传感区域，沿刻度加兼容猫砂。远离宠物手动运行一次，确认正常再开计划。
content.en:
Ensure the cat is away, pause cycles and unplug. Wear gloves, tie the removed liner and follow local waste rules.

Wash the removable tray with mild detergent and dry. Wipe the powered base only; clear dust from entry and sensors.

Secure new liner edges without covering sensors and fill compatible litter to the line. Test a manual cycle with pets clear before restoring schedules.

summary.zh-CN: 先暂停断电，再拆洗换袋。

title.zh-CN: 加热窝垫清洗与收纳注意事项

content.zh-CN:
断电降温后拆下布套和加热部件。只洗标明可洗的布套，加热片和适配器不入水。

30°C 以下轻柔清洗，避免漂白和高温烘干。拉链与接缝彻底晾干后安装。

平放或沿原折线轻折，勿压重物。再次使用检查线材，破损、焦味或异常发热时停用。
content.en:
Unplug, cool and separate cover from heating parts. Wash only marked washable covers; keep panels and adapters out of water.

Wash gently below 30°C without bleach or high-heat drying. Dry zips and seams fully before assembly.

Store flat or gently along existing folds without heavy loads. Check cables before reuse and stop for damage, burning smells or unusual heat.

summary.zh-CN: 布套可拆洗，电子部件保持干燥。
summary.en: Wash removable covers and keep electronics dry.

title.zh-CN: 演示商城退换与保修政策说明

content.zh-CN:
演示政策设定设备主体保修 12 个月，正常使用功能故障进入评估。耗材消耗、外观磨损与人为损坏不属此示例范围。

演示退货流程为签收后 7 天内申请并核对条件。拆封、使用与卫生状态影响范围，不统一承诺所有用品无条件退货。

在订单售后入口填写型号、现象和使用情况，保留包装配件。正式销售以订单条款和适用规则为准，本页不构成实际服务承诺。
content.en:
The sample policy covers device bodies for 12 months with assessment of normal-use faults. Consumable use, wear and accidental damage are outside this example.

The sample flow accepts requests within seven days of receipt for eligibility review. Opening, use and hygiene affect eligibility; not every item has unconditional returns.

Use order support to record the model, symptoms and usage; retain packaging and parts. Actual sales follow displayed terms and applicable rules. This page is not a real service promise.

summary.zh-CN: 本页为流程示例，正式规则以销售页面为准。
summary.en: This is a sample flow; final terms belong on sales pages.

title.zh-CN: 发货、配送和签收如何查看？

content.zh-CN:
演示流程设定普通订单付款后 48 小时内安排出库，预售以商品页为准。此时效为示例，不代表实际承诺。

订单详情查看发货与配送状态。拆分包裹逐件查看，物流更新可能晚于仓库交接。

签收核对型号、规格和配件，破损先记录再提交问题。保留外箱供评估，电子设备确认干燥完整后通电。
content.en:
The demo schedules standard dispatch within 48 hours; preorders follow product pages. This timing is illustrative, not a delivery commitment.

Check dispatch and delivery in order details. Review split shipments separately; tracking may update after warehouse handover.

Check model, variant and parts. Document damage before reporting it, keep packaging for review, and power electronics only after checking they are dry and intact.

summary.zh-CN: 在订单页看进度，签收时核对配件。
summary.en: Check order progress and inspect accessories on arrival.
